title: Note Lang
description: Coloration, liens entre titres, complétion, plan du fichier et snippets pour la notation Note (.note, .cours)

title: Blocky Renderer
description: 3D preview for Hytale models (.blockymodel) and their animations (.blockyanim), next to the text editor like the Markdown preview or on its own in a separate tab, plus a Blocky Renderer tab with a model browser and node tree.

title: Prefab Renderer
description: Renders Hytale prefabs (*.prefab.json) as an interactive 3D view.

title: Studio ZIP
description: Browse and edit archives directly inside VS Code.

title: Lightweight Whiteboard
description: A whiteboard inside VS Code: draw with custom colors, shapes and a fill bucket, and drop images onto the board.

title: Task Deck
description: Shows all available VSCode tasks, grouped by source, as a collapsible list in the sidebar.

title: Stat Lens
description: Shows statistics for the open workspace: lines of code, languages, Git history, size, dependencies.

title: Agent Chime
description: Plays a sound when Claude Code or Codex finishes in your terminal, and a different one when it needs your approval.

title: AEGIS Totem
description: Create and use repo-native Totems for multi-agent reference and communications.
